title: Existence of normalized ordinary finite scalar endpoints
statement: Let $T$ be a scheme, let $N>0$ be invertible in $\Gamma(T,\mathcal O_T)$, and let $\varphi:A\to B$ be a unital map of finite commutative rings with $NA=NB=0$. The record $\operatorname{P1KummerScalarEndpoints}(\varphi,N,T)$ [def-sp-p1-kummer-scalar-endpoints] is inhabited. Its ordinary insertions send $a$ to $\varphi(a)$ and $a\otimes z$ to $\varphi(a)\otimes z$; its derived isomorphisms are the adjunction transposes specified by that definition. The assertion includes the empty scheme and zero coefficient rings.

proof.text: Construct normalizedConstantMap by the constant sheaf adjunction and construct normalizedLineMap by the Tate-line/root Hom equivalence. Their formulas on constants and pure-root generators are proved directly from those equivalences.

The supported constant scalar-unit theorem applied to the identity immersion gives the ambient constant universal property for any ring map. For residue coefficients, take the empty Cartier divisor: its ideal is top, hence invertible. The unique supported boundaries exist over the residue and target rings. Supported Kummer boundary scalar compatibility supplies a normalized ambient Tate insertion with the derived universal property. Equality on pure-root generators identifies it with the constructed normalizedLineMap.

The residue map to B equals phi composed with the residue map to A, by uniqueness of maps from ZMod N. The constructed Tate insertions compose on generators. Exact-degree-zero unit_comp and cancellation of universal arrows therefore give the universal property for the A-to-B Tate insertion. No coefficient-flatness hypothesis is needed.

The generic exact adjoint-insertion criterion makes both specified derived insertions invertible. Use asIso on those actual constructed maps to fill the endpoint record. The ordinary normalization and derived-normalization fields are exactly the proved formulas and definitional identities.

lean.statement:
theorem p1KummerScalarEndpointExistence
    (T : Scheme.{u}) (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) (hT : IsUnit (N : Γ(T, ⊤)))
    (A B : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [Finite A] [Finite B]
    (φ : A →+* B) (hA : (N : A) = 0) (hB : (N : B) = 0) :
    Nonempty (P1KummerScalarEndpoints φ N hA hB T)

split_report.summary: Reuse existing supported scalar universal data on the empty Cartier divisor, then cancel the residue-to-A universal arrow. This is ambient coefficient extension, not a new purity or base-change argument.
